lead_raw_text:
The structure of CaMg14V crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 24 atoms (Ca2 Mg28 V2) distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Ca, Mg, and V centers adopting 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Mg environments ranging from Mg-only to mixed Mg/Ca/V coordination. The geometric neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions across all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates that Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibit corner, edge, and face sharing, though these relations are not exclusive for all polyhedra.
